watches.name: GM19 - Titan MoonDate Black Out Edition (Quartz)
watches.description: GM19 Titan MoonDate Special “Black Out” Edition Debuts Exclusively at British Watchmakers’ Day 2026 London, UK – 7 March 2026 — In celebration of British Watchmakers’ Day 2026, we are proud to unveil the GM19 Titan MoonDate “Black Out” Edition , a highly exclusive special release launched at the event in London on 7 March 2026 . After a successful launch and the majority of models being snapped up in the first few hours. We are delighted to now release the remaining models worldwide. Created specifically for this landmark gathering of British horology, the Black Out Edition will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis , with the lowest serial numbers reserved for the earliest customers , beginning at BWD-001 . Production is strictly limited to 40 Swiss quartz models and 10 Swiss mechanical models , ensuring rarity and collectability from the moment of release. The GM19 Titan MoonDate marks a significant milestone for the brand as our very first titanium timepiece , combining exceptional strength with lightweight comfort. The refined 39.5mm titanium 5 case reflects the growing demand for more compact, contemporary watch proportions, without compromising presence or performance. At the heart of the Black Out Edition is a striking high-grade Super-LumiNova C3 luminescent moon dial and index markers , delivering vivid legibility. The dial itself is a work of art: a handcrafted copper surface, oil-pressed to replicate the rugged, cratered landscape of Titan , Saturn’s largest moon and one of the most enigmatic bodies in our solar system. The result is a dial rich in texture, depth, and celestial character. The mechanical version is powered by the Swiss Sellita SW200 automatic movement , offering proven reliability and precision with an exhibition case back, while the quartz variant features a Swiss Ronda movement, behind the unique Aventurine designed case back. ideal for those who prioritise ultimate accuracy and low maintenance. Both executions include a distinctive crater-style date window for enhanced readability and robust crown guards for added protection. Built for both adventure and everyday wear, the GM19 Titan MoonDate delivers 100 metres of water resistance and is paired with a 21 x 18mm titanium bracelet , secured by a sleek butterfly clasp. The combination ensures exceptional durability, comfort, and understated elegance. The GM19 Titan MoonDate “Black Out” Edition is more than a watch — it is a celebration of British watchmaking, celestial inspiration, and modern horological design. This limited release offers collectors a rare opportunity to secure a truly distinctive timepiece at the very beginning of its journey. Experience the cosmos on your wrist! Strap Titanium 21 x 18mm Movement Swiss Ronda Power Reserve Battery Case Titanium (Black PVD Coated) Case Size 39.5 mm Case Thickness 9 mm (approx.) Warranty 24 Months Dial Lunar Surface Super LumiNova C3 Glass Sapphire Crystal Water Resistance 10 ATM (100 Meter) Features C3 Super-LumiNova applied to a textured surface for enhanced legibility in low-light transitions and a distinctive visual glow. This is designed as a subtle functional and aesthetic feature rather than a high-intensity illumination.

watches.name: GM19 - Titan MoonDate (Quartz)
watches.description: Introducing the GM19 Titan MoonDate — a groundbreaking addition to our collection that exemplifies innovation, craftsmanship, and cosmic inspiration. As our very first titanium timepiece, this model embodies strength and lightweight comfort, now enhanced with a 39.5mm case size that aligns with the latest trend toward more refined, smaller watches. The GM19 Titan MoonDate features a striking high-grade Super LumiNova C3 luminescent moon dial and index markers, offering vibrant visibility even in the darkest of environments. The dial itself is a meticulously handcrafted masterpiece: a copper surface oil-pressed to mimic the rugged, textured lunar landscape of Titan (Saturns Moon), the second-largest moon in our solar system. This unique dial design captures the mystique and grandeur of our celestial neighbour. Powered by a Swiss Ronda quartz movement , the watch guarantees reliable precision and ultimate accuracy at a more accessible price. Practical yet elegant, it includes a crater date window positioned for optimal readability and robust crown guards for added protection. Designed for adventure and daily wear, the GM19 Titan MoonDate boasts an impressive 100 meters of water resistance, complemented by a 21 x 18mm titanium bracelet with a secure butterfly clasp, this watch offers a perfect blend of durability, comfort, and style. Experience the cosmos on your wrist — a true testament to horological artistry and celestial inspiration. watches.name: PES Special Edition
watches.description: Celebrating British Watch Makers Day: Introducing the PES Special Edition – A Sophisticated Timepiece with a Nod to Tradition By Olivier Meylan. In a tribute to the rich heritage of British watchmaking and as proud members of the British watch making alliance, we are thrilled to announce the exclusive release of only five (5) special edition PES watches on March 8th, 2025, coinciding with British Watch Makers Day. This distinguished model marks a monumental moment as it is the first time the assembly of our timepieces has been conducted in the UK. The PES Special Edition showcases a unique union jack arrow elegantly positioned at 12 o'clock, celebrating British craftsmanship and innovation. As we return to our roots with the Swiss ETA Automatic movement, this timepiece stands not only as a tribute to tradition but also as a formidable competitor amongst the leading luxury Swiss watchmakers. With its bold 42mm diameter, the PES watch makes a statement without sacrificing comfort. Its slim 9.5mm case is crafted from brushed stainless steel and accentuated with black gunmetal PVD coating, perfectly embodying a sophisticated monochrome aesthetic. The flashes of red and blue on the union jack marker, second hand, and the engraved "S" on the crown bring a vibrant touch of colour, celebrating British pride. The exhibition skeleton caseback reveals the heart of the watch – the exceptional 25 jewel Swiss-made ETA 2824 movement. Renowned as a "workhorse" movement, it boasts an impressive 38-hour power reserve, ensuring reliability and performance befitting of any luxury timepiece enthusiast. In addition to its striking design, the PES Special Edition offers versatility with two strap options: a sleek black gunmetal bracelet and an elegant burgundy red leather strap, allowing wearers to express their style on any occasion. The PES Special Edition is not just a watch; it’s a statement of sophistication and a celebration of British watchmaking history, each individually numbered on the reverse. As we unveil this limited edition piece, we invite discerning collectors and watch aficionados to experience a blend of tradition and modernity, along with a unique touch of British charm. Join us in celebrating British Watch Makers Day and secure one of just five exclusive watches. For additional information please contact us. Strap Stainless Steel Bracelet + Interchangeable Leather Strap Movement Swiss ETA 2824 Automatic Water Resistance 5 ATM Case Brushed Stainless Steel Case Size 42 mm Case Thickness 9.5 mm Warranty 24 Months Dial Black Ceramic Glass Sapphire Crystal

watches.name: GM19 - Moonphase (Automatic)
watches.description: Pre Order Now Open: Release Date 31st August 2024 GM19 Moonphase - Unveiling the the latest addition to the GM19 collection, a masterpiece of precision and elegance. Featuring the t he ETA Valjoux caliber 7751, a 25 jewels Swiss made self-winding automatic movement. This extremely multi-functional caliber is based on the legendary ETA Caliber 7750 chronograph, but with additional complications including a full moon phase indicator at 6:00, a central date hand pointing to the date in the outer perimeter of the dial, day of the week and month windows at 12:00, and a 24 hour hand at 9:00. Housed in a high-grade stainless steel 42m case, featuring a blue Swiss Super-Luminova glow to the hour markers, this timepiece is a true work of art. Day, date, and month functions add practicality to luxury. This continues with an exhibition (skeleton) caseback revealing the 25 jewel Swiss made mechanical movement, boasting a 48 hour power reserve, considered to be a “work of art” by many luxury watch enthusiasts. First release of only 100 available WORLDWIDE. Strap Italian (crazy Horse) leather Movement ETA Valjoux caliber 7751 Water Resistance 5 ATM Case Brushed Stainless Steel Case Size 42 mm Case Thickness 9.5 mm (approx.) Warranty 24 Months Dial Black marble Glass Sapphire Crystal Setting the time When setting the date on your caliber 7751, do not attempt to do so while the hands on the watch are displaying between 8:00PM and 2:00AM. Before adjusting anything, be sure to move the hands to a time outside of this zone – this is to make sure the date flipping sequence at midnight has occurred. For the moonphase, do not make adjustments between 8:00PM and 6:00AM. Doing so can cause serious damage to the calendar gears in the movement. Winding – Neutral (position) 1 is hand-winding position. Time – Pull the crown out 2 clicks (position 3). Turn the crown clockwise or counterclockwise to set the time. Day of the week – Use the pusher on the side of the watch near the 10:00 position Date – Pull the crown out one click (position 2) and turn it counterclockwise Month – While in date setting mode (position 2 and turning counterclockwise) continue to change the date until it passes the 31st of the month. This will advance the month indicator to the next month. Keep doing this until your current month is selected, stopping on the day. Moonphase – Pull the crown out one click and turn clockwise until your desired moonphase setting is reached.

watches.name: GM19 - MoonDate
watches.description: Limited Re stock - Now on sale. GM19 MoonDate - Drawn from millions of years of travel in the cosmos. The all new GM19 opens a new chapter in Olivier Meylan's history. The evolution of the classic, astronomy inspired G0811. Mysterious and architectural featuring a unique replica of the face of the moon dial, installed into the GM19 featuring 8 Swiss super-luminova® hour markers representing the 8 planets in our solar system. Cased in our signature 42mm rose gold structure, the watch is on the larger side, but because of its 9.5mm thin case, it never feels big. And thanks to the case’s brushed stainless-steel construction and elements of rose gold PVD coating, it remains true to the watch’s astronomy aesthetic. Powered by a precision Swiss quartz movement boasting extreme accuracy and time keeping. First release of only 100 available WORLDWIDE. Strap Italian (crazy Horse) leather Movement Swiss Quartz Water Resistance 5 ATM Case Brushed Stainless Steel / Rose Gold PVD Case Size 42 mm Case Thickness 9.5 mm (approx.) Warranty 24 Months Dial Moon Dial Glass Sapphire Crystal

watches.name: The Players Edition SPORT
watches.description: Limited Re Stock now live . Delivery expected Mid April 2025 The Players Edition SPORT - The return of the Swiss ETA Automatic. The new Players Edition Sport is not just darkly stylish, but a sophisticated timepiece that challenges some of the leading luxury Swiss watch makers which suits its competitive "sporty" nature and one the reasons this collection gained its listing as best watch brand 2022 by the Independent. At 42mm, the watch is on the larger side, but because of its 9.5mm thin case, it never feels big. And thanks to the case’s brushed stainless-steel construction and elements of black gunmetal PVD coating, it remains true to the watch’s monochrome aesthetic. In fact, the only bit of colour you’ll find are the flashes of red seen on the 12 o'clock marker, second hand and the "S" engraved on the crown. This continues with an exhibition (skeleton) caseback revealing the 25 jewel Swiss made mechanical movement, boasting a 38 hour power reserve, considered to be a “workhorse” movement by many luxury watch enthusiasts. Box hand signed by ambassadors Jack Nowell, Henry Slade, Luke Cowan-Dickie and Dave Ewers marking 10 years of professional Rugby for England & Exeter Chiefs. Strap Stainless Steel Bracelet + Interchangeable Rubber Strap Movement Swiss ETA 2824 Automatic Water Resistance 5 ATM Case Brushed Stainless Steel Case Size 42 mm Case Thickness 9.5 mm Warranty 24 Months Dial Black Ceramic Glass Sapphire Crystal

Meet Laura Wall, A multi-award winning artist based in the seaside town of Teignmouth in Devon where she has an art gallery and studio. She is inspired by the beauty of the coast around her and known for her illustrative pen and watercolour series that captures the spirit of the seaside. Laura’s iconic clouds and seagulls are a core part of every piece of art. Every Laura Wall and every Olivier Meylan piece begins with the same elements: talent, craftsmanship and vision. Today we are delighted to announce our collaboration with Laura, where we bring two artistic concepts and merge them together, introducing the fourth Bijoux model to our collection, customised by Laura.
